title: Geometry - Lesson 7 Practice: Transversal Vocabulary
description: Practice identifying corresponding, alternate interior, alternate exterior, and same-side interior angle pairs.

questions.question: A line crosses two other lines at different points. What is the crossing line called?
questions.explanation: A transversal is a line that intersects two or more lines at different points.

questions.question: In the standard transversal diagram with angles 1-4 at the top intersection and 5-8 at the bottom intersection, which pair is corresponding?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are in matching positions. Angles 1 and 5 are both upper-left positions.

questions.question: Which pair is alternate interior?
questions.explanation: Angles 3 and 6 are between the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

questions.question: Which pair is alternate exterior?
questions.explanation: Angles 1 and 8 are outside the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.

questions.question: Which pair is same-side interior?
questions.explanation: Angles 3 and 5 are both interior and both lie on the same side of the transversal.

questions.question: Alternate interior angles must be between the two lines and on opposite sides of the transversal.
questions.explanation: Both conditions are needed: interior region and opposite sides of the transversal.

questions.question: Angles located between the two lines are called ______ angles.
questions.explanation: Interior angles are the angles in the region between the two lines.

questions.question: Explain why $\angle 4$ and $\angle 6$ are same-side interior angles in the standard transversal diagram.
questions.correctAnswer: They are both between the two lines and on the same side of the transversal.
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles must be interior and located on the same side of the transversal.
